verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents several distinct agents that are selectable from the model picker. Functions can add a custom model or agent, and coding agents like Claude Code or Codex can be picked like any other model. Channels let multiple models take part in shared timelines, and sub-agents can hand off work to a second agent. The pack does not show that each agent can carry its own system prompt and workspace, or that a channel can be explicitly routed to a specific agent. missing for 10: documented per-agent prompt/model/workspace configuration, explicit routing of conversations or channels to specific agents, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can run multiple distinct agents with their own prompts, models, and workspaces, and route conversations or channels to each

citations.quote: Adds a custom model or agent | Appears as a selectable model in the chat sidebar
Pick Claude Code, Codex or another listed agent from the model picker like any other model.
Channels let multiple users and multiple models interact in a single timeline.
Sub-agents let a model hand a focused piece of work to a second agent that runs in parallel, then use the result to continue.
